_comment: C0-17 正文英译 · minimax-audio（2026-10-26）。无附加小节。正文「相关条目」3 行带 .md 链接（elevenlabs/fish-audio/hailuo-video），related 写 3 条（frontmatter related 是 [elevenlabs, fish-audio, hailuo-video]，键按正文链接行对齐=3）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。runs 带「实测建议」三条段。备案句内只有备案号 Shanghai-MiniMax-202505230046（拉丁文本不计），无中文登记名——本页预期 0 B 类。

axes.model_access: MiniMax's self-developed speech/audio model line (speech-02 series models served via API, official docs narrative); dual entry points: web (hailuoai.com/audio and minimax.io/audio) + API platform (platform.minimaxi.com line).
axes.runtime: Web + API; generation on the vendor's cloud. No official open-weights audio-model statement seen (the language models have an open-weights precedent; the audio line does not).
axes.local_files: Generated outputs download to local; account-side retention surfaces not verified item by item. No officially stated local data surface seen.
axes.background: Generation is instant/task-based (API calls produce and return immediately); no "keep-running-after-shutdown" form stated — a cloud service does not depend on your machine being online.
axes.tools: TTS (multilingual/multi-style), **voice cloning/voice design** (official product surface), a music-generation line (music models served via API, official docs narrative); API parameter surfaces (speed/volume/emotion control) documented.
axes.context: Tool-type product with no conversation-memory concept; voice assets are its "consistency" mechanism — cloned voices being reusable is not memory.
axes.permissions: Account + subscription + API billing system (D9: pricing not collected); **voice cloning involves personality rights — the official site has an authorization-framing page, details not verified item by line** (inclusion criterion 3: the clone-authorization line is a must-answer). Filing: MiniMax model filing no. Shanghai-MiniMax-202505230046 (cross-checked on Bailian/Baidu Cloud disclosure pages, 2026-10-22) — the subject is the model layer.
axes.fit: Fits: high-quality Chinese TTS, voice-cloning workflows (with authorization for your own voice), API-integrated voice, domestic direct connection. Does not fit: cloning other people's voices (authorization red line), wanting open weights, running offline.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creation products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **Emotional-performance gap between cloned voices and the official voice library**
- **Whether API and web entry points run synchronized model versions**
- **Actual strictness of the voice-clone authorization verification flow**
unknowns:
- Open weights for the audio models (no official statement verified)
- Filing status of each product entry point itself (not verified one by one)
- The training-use switch (not verified item by item)
- Whether music and speech models share one billing pool (not verified item by item)
related: Both TTS + cloning: ElevenLabs has a wider multilingual surface, MiniMax is stronger in Chinese.
Also cloning-oriented: fish audio leans on its community voice library, MiniMax on its official voice library + API.
Same vendor, different product line: Hailuo Video is the video line, this dossier is the audio line.
